notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Approvals, security alerts and announcements — in one inbox.

select.pageSelected: All {count} messages on this page are selected.

toast.archive: {count, plural, one {Message archived} other {# messages archived}}
toast.unarchive: {count, plural, one {Moved to inbox} other {# messages moved to inbox}}
toast.trash: {count, plural, one {Moved to trash} other {# messages moved to trash}}
toast.restore: {count, plural, one {Message restored} other {# messages restored}}
toast.delete: {count, plural, one {Deleted forever} other {# messages deleted forever}}
toast.read: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to mark} one {Marked as read} other {# marked as read}}
toast.unread: {count, plural, one {Marked as unread} other {# marked as unread}}
toast.unstar: {count, plural, one {Star removed} other {# stars removed}}

compose.title: New announcement
compose.description: Sent to the inbox of everyone in the audience (and by e-mail if they opted in).
compose.subject: Subject
compose.linkHint: An in-app page to open, e.g. /approvals
compose.sent: {count, plural, one {Announcement sent to 1 person} other {Announcement sent to # people}}

validation.title: Enter a subject
validation.link: Use an in-app path such as /approvals

settings.title: Notification settings
settings.description: Choose how you are told about each kind of event.
settings.locked: Security alerts are always shown in the app

hints.APPROVAL: Requests to review and decisions on yours

requested.title: Approval needed: {summary}
requested.body: {maker} requested a change that needs a second person's approval. Review it before {expiresAt}.

approved.title: Approved: {summary}
approved.body: {checker} approved your request and the change has been applied.

failed.title: Could not apply: {summary}
failed.body: {checker} approved your request, but it could not be applied: {error}. Submit it again if it is still needed.

expired.title: Expired: {summary}
expired.body: No checker decided on your request in time, so it expired. Submit it again if it is still needed.

passwordChanged.title: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.body: Your password was changed and your other sessions were signed out. If this wasn't you, contact the security team immediately.

passwordReset.title: Your password was reset by an administrator
passwordReset.body: {by} set a temporary password for your account. You will be asked to choose a new one when you next sign in.

passwordExpiring.title: Your password expires in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
passwordExpiring.body: Change it before {expiresAt} to avoid being asked at sign-in.

accountLocked.title: Your account was locked
accountLocked.body: Too many failed sign-in attempts. The account unlocks automatically at {until}, or an administrator can unlock it. If this wasn't you, change your password.

newSignIn.title: New sign-in to your account
newSignIn.body: Signed in from {device} ({ip}) at {at}. If this wasn't you, change your password and sign out your other sessions.

sessionEvicted.title: Signed out on another device
sessionEvicted.body: You can be signed in on up to {limit} devices at once, so your least recently used session was ended.

mfaEnabled.title: Two-step verification is on
mfaEnabled.body: Your account now asks for a code from your authenticator app at sign-in.

mfaDisabled.title: Two-step verification was turned off
mfaDisabled.body: Your account no longer asks for a second step at sign-in. If this wasn't you, contact the security team.

mfaRequired.title: Set up two-step verification
mfaRequired.body: Your role ({roles}) requires two-step verification. Set up an authenticator app to keep your account secure.

demoRequested.title: New demo request {reference}: {product}
demoRequested.body: {name} requested a {type} demo of {product}. Please contact them within one business day.

inquiryReceived.title: New inquiry {reference}: {product}
inquiryReceived.body: {name} sent a {type} inquiry about {product}. Please respond within one business day.

demoAssigned.title: Demo request {reference} assigned to you
demoAssigned.body: You now own the demo request from {name} for {product}. Please contact them within one business day.

inquiryAssigned.title: Inquiry {reference} assigned to you
inquiryAssigned.body: You now own the inquiry from {name} about {product}. Please respond within one business day.
